trap.label: would × passado simples (narrativa)
trap.wrong: Every night Clara would to leave a warm meal, and a cleaner would leave a note once.
trap.right: Every night Clara would leave a warm meal, and a cleaner left a note once.
trap.why: Em português “deixava” e “deixou” diferem só pelo tempo. Em inglês, ação repetida = would/used to; ação única = Past Simple.

mcq.q: She ___ leave a warm meal every night.

fix.wrong: She would leave a note yesterday.
Every day she left a warm meal.
fix.right: Every day she would leave a warm meal.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva como hábito: “She left a warm meal every night.” (would)
rewrite.answer: She would leave a warm meal every night.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva como fato: “He would leave a note once.”
